message: COPY DBTBLS (lines 19-21) sits under 01 WS-ERRLOG-REC, but the copybook records POSHIST-RECORD and ERRLOG-RECORD are themselves level 01. Registered as EXPANDS_COPY from the enclosing 01 record (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0056-REC-0001) as written; its total_bytes (937 = 166 + 771) includes the copybook records and its inline_bytes is 0.

COPY DBTBLS REPLACING ==ERRLOG-RECORD== BY ==WS-ERRLOG-REC== renames copybook record ERRLOG-RECORD to WS-ERRLOG-REC, the same name as the enclosing 01 at line 18. The expanded record is displayed as WS-ERRLOG-REC_R; the registry keeps the copybook identity SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0016-REC-0002.
EXEC SQL BEGIN/END DECLARE SECTION (lines 17-22) encloses 01 WS-ERRLOG-REC and COPY DBTBLS; the host variables are recorded as ordinary WORKING-STORAGE items.

COPY SQLCA (line 24), COPY DBPROC (line 25) and COPY ERRHAND (line 26) sit directly under the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION with no enclosing 01. Linked by EXPANDS_COPY from section SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0056-SEC-0002; their bytes (35; 118; 8+10+370+8+240) count only in the copybooks' own records, not in this file's total_bytes.
Copybook DBPROC (expanded at line 25 in WORKING-STORAGE) also contains procedure code (inventory: CALL 'ERRPROC' at DBPROC line 56); only its data record DB2-ERROR-HANDLING is expanded.
